reports.title: Skyworks Begins New Chapter Following Qorvo Combination; Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results

guidance.heading: First Fiscal Quarter 2027 Outlook
section: We provide earnings guidance on a non-GAAP basis because certain information necessary to reconcile such guidance to GAAP is difficult to estimate and dependent on future events outside of our control. Please refer to the attached Discussion Regarding the Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures in this earnings release for further discussion of our use of non-GAAP measures, including quantification of known expected adjustment items.

“For the December quarter, our first as a combined company, we anticipate revenue of $1.80 billion to $1.90 billion. At the midpoint, this includes approximately $1.07 billion from legacy Skyworks and approximately $780 million from legacy Qorvo; this is the last quarter in which we will provide this split,” said Philip Carter. “Qorvo’s September quarter included an extra week, which contributed approximately $70 million of revenue. Our outlook at the midpoint is down approximately 7 percent sequentially from combined September revenue, or approximately 3 percent excluding the extra week. At the midpoint of the revenue range, we expect non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.25, based on approximately 241 million diluted shares and including approximately $50 million of other expense, primarily interest on the acquisition financing.
“We expect Smartphone revenue to decline in the low teens percent sequentially, reflecting seasonality, well-known softness in the Android market as we remain focused on the premium tier, and the

extra week in Qorvo’s September quarter. We expect Diversified Growth Markets revenue to grow in the low single digits sequentially, despite the extra week in the prior quarter, and in the high single to low double digits year-over-year on a combined basis, representing more than 40 percent of sales, led by data center and defense.

“Our December-quarter outlook reflects only the early stages of synergy realization. We expect to realize approximately $150 million of synergies in operating expenses within fiscal 2027, weighted to the second half of the year, and to exit fiscal 2027 at an annualized run-rate of approximately $250 million to $300 million. We remain fully committed to $500 million or more of annual cost synergies within 24 to 36 months of close.”
Skyworks’ Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Conference Call

Skyworks will host a conference call with analysts to discuss its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 results, the completed combination with Qorvo and its business outlook on Nov. 3, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. EST.
